notes:
Inbound lead (Shopify merchant). Signed up self-serve and used free credits to poke at embeddings + small-chat experiments. Lightweight discovery — wants low-friction path to replace rule-based product Q&A widget and to bulk-enrich product descriptions overnight.

Timeline (short):
- 2025-11-05: Account created via hosted signup; onboarded with walkthrough email. (signup attribution: Shopify app directory)
- 2025-11-07: Discovery call (ff_20251107_pearlbox_discovery_call). Attendees: CTO Erin Morales, Head of Product Samir Rao, AE Alex Kim, SE Riley Chen.
- 2025-11-10: Tech follow-up—shared sample prompt templates and embedding mapping doc.
- Target: POC w/ hosted API + small caching layer in prod storefront week of 11/18. POC scope: product Q&A widget (10k SKUs), nightly enrichment job for 50k SKUs, search re-ranking on top-200 queries.

Key requirements / notes:
- Workload: mostly read/QA on product pages (product_qna), occasional long-tail support chat; catalog enrichment to auto-generate bullet points + ALT text.
- Traffic pattern: baseline low (5–10 qps), bursty spikes during promotions/holiday up to 200–400 qps for short windows; typical concurrent > burst tolerance unknown.
- Latency SLO: prefer <300ms median for product Q&A. Will accept slightly higher tail if cost tradeoff is clear.
- Throughput target for POC: support 30–60 req/s sustained during peak with automatic graceful degradation (fallback to cached answers).
- Cost sensitivity: high — wants predictable cost envelope; target cost per QA request < $0.005 after batching/caching.
- Model strategy (requested): small open LLM + embeddings for retrieval; fallback path to higher-quality model for ambiguous queries. Interested in Redwood recommendations for quantized variants.
- Integration: Shopify storefront JS widget + server-side enrichment pipeline (Nightly job). Wants a simple webhook/SDK example for Shopify theme apps.
- Security/compliance: US data residency preferred; 30-day retention; audit logs required for merchant billing partners. Legal wants a short doc that states hosted_api data handling and retention.

Direct quote (CTO): "If we can get answers under 300ms and predictable costs during Black Friday, we can roll this to all merchants. We can't have surprise bills."

Open action items / AE notes:
- AE to send hosted API quickstart + test key (assigned 11/12).
- SE to produce cost estimate for 10k/day baseline and 150k/day burst scenario with caching assumptions. Include sample batching configs and KV-prefix caching notes.
- Provide Shopify integration stub (theme + app route) and sample prompt templates for product Q&A and description enrichment.
- Legal: prepare two-sentence retention/residency blurb for initial go/no-go.

Potential to expand: If POC meets latency & cost targets, expect Dedicated evaluation for predictable throughput next Q2. For now, strong fit for hosted_api self-serve with early SE support.
use_case_summary: SMB Shopify merchant using hosted API for product Q&A, nightly catalog enrichment across 50k SKUs, and search reranking. Priority: low-latency storefront answers, cost predictability for holiday bursts.
notes_short: Self-serve signup -> discovery call; POC week of 11/18; main blockers: cost estimates for bursty traffic, Shopify integration path, legal retention language.
